description: This file contains the Polymer library's core JavaScript code, defining the Polymer object, base classes, behaviors, and registration mechanisms for custom elements, along with some initialization code.

classes.name: Polymer.Base
classes.description: Base class providing core functionality for Polymer elements, including lifecycle callbacks, property management, behaviors, and attribute synchronization.

classes.name: Polymer.Base.DomModule
classes.description: Represents a DOM module for defining custom elements and their templates.

methods.name: Polymer
methods.description: Function to define a new Polymer element, extending its prototype and registering it.

methods.name: Polymer.telemetry._regLog
methods.description: Logs registration of a Polymer element prototype.

methods.name: Polymer.RenderStatus.whenReady
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked when Polymer rendering is ready.

methods.name: Polymer.Base._addFeature
methods.description: Adds features or behaviors to the Polymer base class.
